prompt: Single game enemy sprite: A greedy, sly goblin-kin brigand, the Urn Thief, drawn as a chunky grimy cartoon character about 3 heads tall: a BIG head with huge pointed ears, a round pot belly, thick short bowed legs in big rag-wrapped boots, long thick arms and BIG clawed hands, upright and menacing, never cute, never a mascot. His face is built from the fewest bold shapes: a thick angular dark brow shape, TWO BOLD GLOWING lime eye shapes with no pupils as the brightest points of the face, a big hooked nose shape, and a wide mouth drawn as ONE dark shape with a few big pale pointed teeth; the skin in two flat tones; no hair, a bald head. TWO ARMS OF EXACTLY THE SAME SIZE AND LENGTH and TWO LEGS OF EXACTLY THE SAME SIZE AND LENGTH. SIGNATURE: strapped to his back with two thick leather straps is ONE huge cracked clay urn, as tall as his whole body, with a cork stopper and a big zigzag crack, and thick drips of toxic lime goo oozing from the crack drawn as a few big flat drip shapes; the urn is seen behind his shoulder. He wears a ragged plum cloak tied at the neck, hanging behind him with a torn pointed hem, a patched plum vest over the belly, and a wide brown leather belt with a big rusty buckle. In his hand on the LEFT side of the image he holds ONE oversized notched cleaver, a big wide iron blade with a chipped edge, held low at his side with the tip pointing down and a little forward, the whole blade clear of the legs and inside the frame; the other hand is an empty clawed fist of the same size. COLOUR PLAN with strict harmony: ONE dominant hue, a muted plum (hue about 285 degrees), used in four values only: shadow #3A2742, base #5C3F68, light #8B6BA0, top highlight #C2A8D0, for the cloak and the vest. ONE warm family for the skin, the leather, the boots and the urn: olive-green skin #7C8A4A with shadow #55612F and light #A9B66B, leather #6A4430 and #4A2E22, clay urn #B5643A with shadow #7E3F22 and light #D98A58. Iron neutrals for the cleaver and the buckle: #8A8C8E, shadow #5B5E62, light #C9CBCC. ONE small accent family, toxic lime #C9E04A with shadow #86A01F, ONLY on the goo drips and the glowing eyes. Rules: large areas are mid values; only the eyes and the goo are strongly saturated; every shadow is a darker tint of its own colour, never black; every light is a warmer, paler tint of its own colour, never pure white; the outline is a dark mauve-brown #2B1E22. SIDE VIEW from a high top-down camera: facing RIGHT toward the right edge of the screen, the body turned only about 30 degrees toward the viewer so the face and the front of the chest are visible, the far arm and leg partly hidden behind the body. Not a flat profile, not a front view, not a diagonal three-quarter view toward the bottom-right. Standing UPRIGHT in a calm, menacing ready stance with a living pose: the body upright, the head tilted about 8 degrees forward, the weight on one leg with the other knee a little bent, both feet on ONE horizontal ground line, the cleaver held at rest. Full body, centered, filling about 70% of the frame height, drawn about half a head smaller than wanted. At most four colour families. Everything stays inside the frame with margin on every side. Background: one flat solid pure magenta color (#FF00FF) everywhere, no gradient, no ground, no cast shadow, no scenery, no text, no border. Do not use magenta or pink anywhere on the subject. Style: stylized 2D vector cartoon game art for a fantasy tower defense game, in the manner of a chunky cartoon enemy illustration, designed to read at about 40 pixels tall, so every shape is even bolder and simpler than for a larger sprite. Chunky rounded bean-like volumes with slight squash and stretch, big simple shapes with a bold silhouette, exaggerated proportions with the head, the hands and the urn enlarged and the legs shrunk. Colour: flat solid fills in 3 to 4 stacked hard-edged tones (a shadow tone shifted toward a cooler hue, the base, a lighter tone, and one bright highlight shape on top), with the large areas kept in MID values so the figure stays readable when shrunk; no gradients, no airbrush, no painterly texture, no noise, no realistic rendering. Thick clean dark mauve-brown outlines (never pure black), clearly thicker on the outer silhouette and thinner for inner lines, with rounded joins. A few small flat speckle spots of a lighter or darker tone are scattered on the cloak, the skin and the urn. Medium detail only: details are bold simple shapes (one urn, one crack, a few drips, a buckle), no fine engraving, no tiny patterns, no thin lines. High top-down camera tilted about 60 degrees; light comes from the top-left.
